bullets.text: Kids Hacking Schools - Students are behind over half of personal data breaches in UK schools, warns **ICO**.
Apple's iPhone Security Boost - New **Memory Integrity Enforcement** feature enhances security against spyware on iPhone 17.
Hypertension Alerts Approved - **Apple Watch** receives FDA clearance for hypertension notifications, launching next week.
Apple Watch Health Features - New hypertension alerts and **Sleep Score** feature coming with watchOS 26.
Gmail's New Feature - **Gmail** introduces a 'Purchases' tab for easy tracking of package deliveries.
AI Chatbot Regulation Inquiry - **FTC** launches inquiry into AI chatbot companions for minors amid safety concerns.
Tesla's Robotaxi Testing - **Tesla** receives permit to test autonomous vehicles on public streets in Nevada.
AI in NFL Broadcasts - **Amazon** enhances Thursday Night Football with AI features for better viewer insights.
